title: Calibration without Ground Truth
abstract: arXiv:2601.19862v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a label-free post-processing framework that improves a strong but miscalibrated primary model using a weaker yet better-calibrated reference. Our key insight is that strict worst-case improvement is possible if and only if the two models are not mutually calibrated, meaning there does not exist a joint distribution over their reports and outcomes such that both predictions are simultaneously calibrated. We formalize this condition and connect it to no-arbitrage results from economics. Under this condition, we develop an efficient post-processing algorithm for the strong model's outputs based on Bregman projection, with a strict worst-case performance improvement guarantee. Experiments on three 8B LLM families across three multiple-choice benchmarks show that our method reduces the primary model's ECE by over $40\%$ on common benchmarks.

translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种无需标签的后处理框架，该框架利用一个较弱但校准更好的参考模型来改进一个强大但校准不佳的主模型。我们的关键洞察是：严格的最坏情况改进当且仅当两个模型互不校准时才可能实现，即不存在一个关于两者预测报告和结果的联合分布，使得两者的预测能够同时校准。我们对这一条件进行了形式化，并将其与经济学中的无套利结果联系起来。在该条件下，我们开发了一种基于Bregman投影的高效后处理算法，用于处理强模型的输出，并具有严格的最坏情况性能改进保证。在三个8B大语言模型家族和三个多选基准上的实验表明，我们的方法在常见基准上将主模型的期望校准误差（ECE）降低了40%以上。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需真实标签的后处理框架，证明了当强弱两个模型互不校准时可以严格改进强模型的最坏情况校准性能，并通过基于Bregman投影的算法将主模型ECE降低40%以上。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a label-free post-processing framework that shows strict worst-case calibration improvement is possible if and only if two models are not mutually calibrated, using a Bregman projection-based algorithm to reduce the primary model's ECE by over 40%.
